credits.title: Kiiroiko
credits.overview: In Taipei, a Deaf man named Chen encounters a lost Japanese Deaf child. As Chen bonds with the child, he begins to grapple with his long-buried memories.

credits.title: Living in Two Worlds
credits.overview: Dai grows up in a small town, interpreting for his loving deaf parents, until he moves to Tokyo in search of his own independent life.
